arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Bansal argued the case concerns the meaning of the AEDPA tolling provision.
Ms. Loewenberg argued the opposing side should be accountable for all time taken.
Ms. Loewenberg stated only the opposing side can control that time period.
